description: The single durable commit for the accepted items of a batch fails.

expected_upstream.notes: Upstream writes item by item; a failing write yields a 500 entry in details while earlier items stay stored.

expected_holocron.notes: No item stored; whole request 503 with Retry-After. A request is never half stored because of storage (docs/decisions/0005, batch commit). The unchanged tracker and recorder never retry, so the event is lost on the client; refusals count in refused_backpressure{route, reason} and show as lost client events. Retry-After helps only server integrations. One such refusal during the agreed 500 events/s burst fails the capacity gate.

validation_reason: Needs a storage fault injected into Holocron. Upstream behaviour is from source reading.
